# Mortal Shell 2 Wiki

> Mortal Shell 2 Wiki — complete guides for the 2026 soulslike: interactive map, all Shell locations and builds, boss strategies, weapons database, full walkthrough, and patch notes. Fan-made resource, updated as we play through the game.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/): Mortal Shell 2 guide homepage — game overview, key mechanics, and links to every section.
- [Interactive Map](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/map): Full interactive map with all Shell locations, Tarstones, Beacons, boss arenas, and hidden collectibles.
- [All Shells](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/shells): Every playable Shell with stats, abilities, and exact locations.
- [Mortal Shell 2 Bosses](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/bosses): All 8 bosses from Open Beta. Attack patterns, weak points, confirmed regions, and strategy cards for each encounter.
- [Best Builds](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/builds): Eight Mortal Shell 2 builds ranked by playstyle — tank, pure DPS, agile, spellcaster, poison DOT, summoner, hybrid, and beginner setups with recommended shells and talent order.
- [Weapons Database](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/weapons): Complete weapons list with stats, scaling, special moves, and find locations.
- [Full Walkthrough](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/walkthrough): Step-by-step walkthrough covering every area, every boss, and every ending.
- [Beginner Tips](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/tips): Essential tips for new players — mechanics explained, early-game priorities, mistakes to avoid.
- [Patch Notes & Updates](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/updates): Latest updates, balance changes, bug fixes, and new content.

## Builds

- [Tank Build](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/builds#tank): Tier A — soak damage and hold the line. Recommended shell: Black Beard.
- [Pure DPS Build](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/builds#dps): Tier A — raw burst to end fights in short lethal windows.
- [Agile Build](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/builds#agile): Tier S — dodge-rolled aggression. Recommended shell: Tiel the Acolyte.
- [Spellcaster Build](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/builds#mage): Tier A — high-risk, high-reward ranged elemental damage. Recommended shell: Eredrim the Venerable.
- [Poison DOT Build](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/builds#poison-dot): Tier A — stack poison and let the tick finish the job. Recommended shell: Dommy Mommy.
- [Summoner Build](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/builds#summoner): Tier B — let your minions fight while you manage the room.
- [Hybrid Build](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/builds#hybrid): Tier A — a jack of all trades setup that responds to anything. Recommended shell: Harros the Vassal.
- [Beginner Build](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/builds#beginner): Tier B — low bar, high forgiveness. Safest way to learn Mortal Shell 2.
